- Large lesion running parallel to leaf veins, several inches long
- Dark brown/black center area with tan-brown margins
- Possible dark fruiting structures visible in lesion center
- Pinkish midrib/sheath visible

Top candidates: **Northern_Leaf_Blight** (cigar-shaped tan lesions) or **Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot_And_Top_Dieback** (spindle-shaped with dark margins and black fruiting structures).

Let me view a reference image for Northern Leaf Blight.

The NLB reference shows lighter tan/white cigar-shaped lesions without the dark centers seen in the test image. NLB doesn't match well.

The test image's dark brown/black center with brown-purple margins and spindle shape fits **Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot_And_Top_Dieback** better:
- Large spindle-shaped lesion (up to 5-6 inches)
- Dark brown/black area in center consistent with black acervuli (fruiting structures)
- Dark brown to purple margins matching the description exactly
- Leaf is the affected part, consistent with anthracnose leaf spot
